placeChecked(Level, ProtectionContext, BlockPos, Direction, BlockState, BooleanSupplier) - Method in class com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.platform.ForgeBucketOperations
Records the placement with Forge's block-snapshot capture and posts EntityPlaceEvent for it as the context's actor, as ForgeHooks.onPlaceItemIntoWorld does around useOn: a refusal restores the recorded blocks, and an accepted placement then runs the block placement and neighbor updates that capture deferred.
